author: Elijah Jero
name: GalaxyRedCogs
short: Cogs for Red-DiscordBot by Elijah Jero / Galaxy Studios.
description: A collection of Red-DiscordBot cogs covering moderation, translation, music links, tournament integration, elections, and more. Third-party cogs in this repo retain their original authors.
install_msg: Thanks for adding GalaxyRedCogs! Use `[p]cog list GalaxyRedCogs` to see available cogs, then `[p]cog install GalaxyRedCogs <cog_name>` to install one. See the GitHub README for setup notes — some cogs need API keys or extra pip packages.
